facts.fact: ARME, Cape Verde's multisectoral regulator, launched a public consultation on a proposed regulatory framework for satellite communication networks and services, with submissions open until 31 August 2026.

facts.fact: The Government of Cabo Verde put the Portal da Transparencia, a fiscal transparency portal, out to public consultation from 27 June to 17 July 2025.

note: The document covers an open data policy and portal commitment and states no online consultation, standing consultation channel or absence of participation.
